# Open and edit files
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Open a project file in a file view pane, make changes, and review saved changes.

## Open a file

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/workspaces_tabs_and_panes/file_view_pane_opening.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/workspaces_tabs_and_panes/file_view_pane.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

Open the **File explorer** sidebar section and select a file, or use **⌘P** and search by file name. Heidrun Code opens the file in a file view pane.

## Edit and save a file

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/workspaces_tabs_and_panes/file_view_pane_editing.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/PaneCard.vue -->

Edit the text in the file view pane and use its save control. If you close a pane with unsaved changes or quit Heidrun Code, respond to the confirmation before proceeding; the pane indicates when its contents have not been saved.

## Review file changes

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/workspaces_tabs_and_panes/diff_pane.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/source_control.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/DiffPane.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/SourceControlPanel.vue -->

Open **Source control** and select a changed file to view its differences in a diff pane. A diff pane is read-only; edit the file in its file view pane.
